text:
DJIA Market Happenings For Tuesday, August 7, 2018 Posted by admin on August 7th, 2018
Dow stocks at 52 week highs include Apple (AAPL), Disney (DIS), Merck (MRK) and Pfizer (PFE). There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open up +111 points.
Monday the Dow was up +39.60 (+0.16%) at 25,502.18.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +3.17%.
There were 23 Dow stocks up Monday.
The Dow stock winners Monday were led by Disney (DIS) +1.62% and DowDPont (DWDP) +1.41%.
The Dow stock losers Monday were led by IBM (IBM) -1.13% and Intel (INTC) -0.66%.
Disney (DIS) reports earnings today after the close.
European stocks are higher and Asian markets ended higher.
The national average price of gasoline is down two-tenths of a cent at $2.863 per gallon.
